Lead vocal clearly in front of the band. No English lyrics, no autotune, no trot, no K-pop gloss, no distorted guitar, no guitar solo. Bright airy modern mix, not retro.

songs.title: Until Only the Room Is Left
songs.description: Free rhythm timed by breathing: a short phrase, then a stop, then the room goes quiet. One solo daegeum, a large Korean bamboo transverse flute, in its low register. Each phrase is shorter than the one before: three notes, then two, then one, then only breath. Only five pitches in the whole piece: A, C, D, E, G. No other notes, no augmented second, no bent quarter tones. Air enters each note slowly, no tonguing, membrane buzz absent. Close and dry, one mic in a small wooden room, short tail, nothing held underneath, only room tone in the gaps. Every phrase settles on the low A; at the end of a long tone the pitch falls slowly to the next note of the scale. The figure returns, never the same length twice. Sleep music. No vocals. One instrument alone: no ensemble, no second instrument, no percussion, no piano, no guitar, no strings, no synth, no pad, no drone. No rain, no nature sounds. No crescendo, no climax.
